title: "Cluster analysis of individual computational profiles"
output: html_document
date: "2025-11-12"
---

K-means clustering of participants' computational parameters (gamma_help,
gamma_punish, k_help, k_punish) from the joint Model 1-4 fit (Study 1B + 2B
pooled; N = 169), produced by stan_model_Cluster_Analysis.Rmd.

Output map:
- Figure S8A (elbow + silhouette) -> FigureS8A_elbow.png + FigureS8A_silhouette.png
- Figure S8B (PCA space)          -> FigureS8B_pca.png
- Exploratory parameter boxplots -> Figure12A_parameters.png  [diagnostic only; not in final manuscript/SOM]
- Figure 3A  (radar profiles)     -> Figure3A_radar.png
- Figure S8A (silhouette, right)  -> FigureS8A_silhouette.png
- Table 1 (sizes + mean params)   -> printed below

The behavioral signatures of the subtypes (Figure 3B) are produced by
behavior_analysis.Rmd.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries-and-theme}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggplot2, scales, factoextra, rstatix, multcompView,
               patchwork)

rootdir         <- "D:/DJ/JEPG/Cluster_Analysis"
data_savedir    <- paste0(rootdir, "/data/")
stanfit_savedir <- paste0(rootdir, "/output/stanfits/")
plot_savedir    <- paste0(rootdir, "/output/figures/")
if (!dir.exists(plot_savedir)) dir.create(plot_savedir, recursive = TRUE)

# Green palette for the four subtypes (light -> dark), keyed by subtype code
subtype_levels <- c("B", "E", "C", "D")
subtype_colors <- c("B" = "#A1D99B", "E" = "#74C476", "C" = "#238B45", "D" = "#00441B")
subtype_name   <- c("B" = "Balanced observers",
                    "E" = "Equity-preferred evaluators",
                    "C" = "Compensatory moralists",
                    "D" = "Delay-averse evaluators")
seq_low  <- "#E5F5E0"; seq_high <- "#00441B"

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 16, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 8)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 8)),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm"))
}
theme_set(theme_nature())
```

# 1. Load joint-fit parameters and standardize

```{r load-params}
target_pars <- c("gamma_help", "gamma_punish", "k_help", "k_punish")

df_wide <- read_csv(paste0(stanfit_savedir, "winmodel_DJ_all_rescale_m1-4_indpm.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(pars_name %in% target_pars) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pars_name, values_from = pars_value) %>%
  na.omit()

# z-standardize the four parameters before clustering
param_matrix <- scale(df_wide[, target_pars])
```

# 2. Number of clusters: elbow and silhouette (Figure S8A)

```{r figure-S8A-elbow}
p_wss <- fviz_nbclust(param_matrix, kmeans, method = "wss") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray35", linewidth = 0.9) +
  labs(x = "Number of clusters (k)", y = "Total within-cluster sum of squares") +
  theme_nature()
for (i in seq_along(p_wss$layers)) p_wss$layers[[i]]$aes_params$colour <- "gray25"
ggsave(file.path(plot_savedir, "FigureS8A_elbow.png"), p_wss, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

p_sil <- fviz_nbclust(param_matrix, kmeans, method = "silhouette") +
  labs(x = "Number of clusters (k)", y = "Average silhouette width") +
  theme_nature()
for (i in seq_along(p_sil$layers)) p_sil$layers[[i]]$aes_params$colour <- "gray25"
ggsave(file.path(plot_savedir, "FigureS8A_silhouette.png"), p_sil, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# 3. K-means clustering (k = 4) and subtype labeling

```{r kmeans}
set.seed(123)
km_res <- kmeans(param_matrix, centers = 4, nstart = 25)
df_wide$cluster <- as.factor(km_res$cluster)

# Variance accounted for by the 4-cluster solution (main text: 54%)
cat(sprintf("Variance accounted for (betweenss/totss) = %.1f%%\n",
            100 * km_res$betweenss / km_res$totss))

# Label the four clusters from their centroid signatures, independent of the
# arbitrary k-means numbering:
#   D = steepest temporal discounting; E = strongest (symmetric) inequity aversion;
#   C = largest compensation-vs-punishment asymmetry in gamma; B = the remainder.
ctr        <- as.data.frame(km_res$centers)
id_D       <- which.max(rowMeans(ctr[, c("k_help", "k_punish")]))
rem        <- setdiff(1:4, id_D)
id_E       <- rem[which.max(rowMeans(ctr[rem, c("gamma_help", "gamma_punish")]))]
rem        <- setdiff(rem, id_E)
id_C       <- rem[which.max(abs(ctr$gamma_help - ctr$gamma_punish)[rem])]
id_B       <- setdiff(rem, id_C)

cluster_code <- setNames(c("B", "E", "C", "D"),
                         as.character(c(id_B, id_E, id_C, id_D)))
df_wide$subtype <- factor(cluster_code[as.character(df_wide$cluster)], levels = subtype_levels)
df_wide$subtype_label <- factor(subtype_name[as.character(df_wide$subtype)],
                                levels = subtype_name[subtype_levels])
```

# 4. Table 1: subtype labels, sizes, and mean parameters

```{r table-1}
table1 <- df_wide %>%
  group_by(subtype) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            pct        = round(100 * n() / nrow(df_wide), 1),
            gamma_C    = round(mean(gamma_help), 2),
            gamma_P    = round(mean(gamma_punish), 2),
            kappa_C    = round(mean(k_help), 2),
            kappa_P    = round(mean(k_punish), 2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = subtype_name[as.character(subtype)]) %>%
  arrange(subtype)
print(as.data.frame(table1))
```

# 5. Figure S8B: subtypes in principal-component space

```{r figure-S8B-pca}
km_plot <- km_res
km_plot$cluster <- factor(subtype_name[cluster_code[as.character(km_res$cluster)]],
                          levels = subtype_name[subtype_levels])

p_pca <- fviz_cluster(km_plot, data = param_matrix,
                      palette = unname(subtype_colors[subtype_levels]),
                      geom = "point", pointsize = 2.6,
                      ellipse.type = "norm", ellipse.alpha = 0.12, ellipse.level = 0.95,
                      ggtheme = theme_nature()) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Principal component 1", y = "Principal component 2",
       color = "Subtype", fill = "Subtype", shape = "Subtype")
ggsave(file.path(plot_savedir, "FigureS8B_pca.png"), p_pca, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# 6. Exploratory diagnostic: parameter distributions by subtype (not in final manuscript/SOM)

```{r exploratory-parameter-distributions, eval=FALSE}
subtype_cols <- subtype_colors[subtype_levels]

df_param_long <- df_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(subtype, gamma_help, gamma_punish, k_help, k_punish) %>%
  pivot_longer(-subtype, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(parameter = factor(parameter,
            levels = c("gamma_help", "gamma_punish", "k_help", "k_punish"),
            labels = c("gamma[C]", "gamma[P]", "kappa[C]", "kappa[P]")))

# Compact-letter display from Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn post-hoc (Bonferroni)
cld_tbl <- df_param_long %>% group_split(parameter) %>% purrr::map_dfr(function(d) {
  dt <- dunn_test(d, value ~ subtype, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
  pv <- setNames(dt$p.adj, paste(dt$group1, dt$group2, sep = "-"))
  L  <- multcompLetters(pv, threshold = 0.05)$Letters
  ws <- d %>% group_by(subtype) %>% summarise(w = max(value), .groups = "drop")
  rng <- diff(range(d$value))
  tibble(parameter = d$parameter[1], subtype = names(L), cld = unname(L)) %>%
    left_join(ws, by = "subtype") %>% mutate(y = w + 0.06 * rng)
})
cld_tbl$subtype <- factor(cld_tbl$subtype, levels = subtype_levels)

p_params <- ggplot(df_param_long, aes(x = subtype, y = value, fill = subtype)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.60, linewidth = 0.55, outlier.size = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = cld_tbl, aes(x = subtype, y = y, label = cld), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 4.4, fontface = "bold", color = "gray20") +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1, labeller = label_parsed) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subtype_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "Subtype", y = "Parameter value") + theme_nature()

ggsave(file.path(plot_savedir, "Figure12A_parameters.png"), p_params, width = 11, height = 3.6, dpi = 300)
```

# 7. Figure 3A: radar profiles of the four subtypes

```{r figure-3A-radar}
param_cols <- c("gamma_help", "gamma_punish", "k_help", "k_punish")

cl_means <- df_wide %>% group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(param_cols), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
cl_n <- df_wide %>% count(cluster)

# min-max normalize the subtype means (with 15% padding) for the radar shape
p_min <- apply(cl_means[param_cols], 2, min); p_max <- apply(cl_means[param_cols], 2, max)
pad <- 0.15 * (p_max - p_min); lo <- p_min - pad; hi <- p_max + pad
cl_norm <- cl_means
cl_norm[param_cols] <- mapply(function(x, l, h) pmax(0, pmin(1, (x - l) / (h - l))),
                              cl_means[param_cols], lo, hi)

make_radar <- function(vals, title_str, col, n_grid = 4) {
  n <- length(vals)
  angles <- seq(pi/2, pi/2 - 2*pi, length.out = n + 1)[-(n + 1)]
  poly_df <- data.frame(x = c(vals * cos(angles), vals[1] * cos(angles[1])),
                        y = c(vals * sin(angles), vals[1] * sin(angles[1])))
  grid_df <- lapply(seq_len(n_grid) / n_grid, function(r) {
    theta <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 300)
    data.frame(x = r * cos(theta), y = r * sin(theta), r = r) }) %>% bind_rows()
  LR <- 1.32
  axis_df <- data.frame(x1 = cos(angles), y1 = sin(angles),
                        lx = LR * cos(angles), ly = LR * sin(angles),
                        lbl = c("gamma[C]", "gamma[P]", "kappa[C]", "kappa[P]"),
                        hjust = (1 - cos(angles)) / 2, vjust = (1 - sin(angles)) / 2)
  pts_df <- data.frame(x = vals * cos(angles), y = vals * sin(angles))
  ggplot() +
    geom_path(data = grid_df, aes(x, y, group = r), color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_segment(data = axis_df, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = x1, yend = y1),
                 color = "gray85", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_polygon(data = poly_df, aes(x, y), fill = col, alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
    geom_path(data = poly_df, aes(x, y), color = col, linewidth = 1.4) +
    geom_point(data = pts_df, aes(x, y), color = col, fill = "white",
               shape = 21, size = 3.2, stroke = 1.2) +
    geom_text(data = axis_df, aes(x = lx, y = ly, label = lbl, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
              size = 7.5, fontface = "bold", color = "gray15", parse = TRUE) +
    ggtitle(title_str) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.7, 1.7), ylim = c(-1.7, 1.7), clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold", color = "gray20",
                                    lineheight = 1.0),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 22, b = 10, l = 22))
}

radar_plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cl_norm)), function(i) {
  cl <- cl_norm$cluster[i]
  code <- cluster_code[as.character(cl)]
  N <- cl_n$n[cl_n$cluster == cl]
  make_radar(unlist(cl_norm[i, param_cols]),
             paste0(gsub(" ", "\n", subtype_name[code]), "\n(N = ", N, ")"),
             col = subtype_colors[code])
})
p_radar <- wrap_plots(radar_plots, nrow = 1)
ggsave(file.path(plot_savedir, "Figure3A_radar.png"), p_radar, width = 16.5, height = 3.7, dpi = 300)
```
